description: This file defines a base interface for DevOps commands within a specific software project, providing constants, method signatures, and nested classes related to DevOps command properties.

classes.name: DevOpsCommand
classes.description: A parameterized interface for all DevOps commands understood by services, extending Command and WithIdButActuallyNot, defining constants and methods related to DevOps command properties.

classes.name: DevOpsCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static class containing definitions for JSON fields used in DevOps commands, specifically serviceName and instance fields.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the DevOps command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders on the command, returns the command itself for chaining.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for DevOps commands.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, fixed as 'devops'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path for the command.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name associated with the command.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the instance index of the service.
